# Lumenfield Spring Recalibration (fiction)

The civic loop feed in Lumenfield carries 12,400 events per dusk window.

A held-out spring 2026 slice showed a false-alert rate of 2.8% before threshold work.

Northstar will publish a dusk-window spec in Q4 2026.

Loop policy is defined as the civic threshold that gates dusk-window alerts.
